title: SIM-1: make the self-collision clause of SIM-1.1 observable
why: Review on PR #10 found SIM-1.1's test infers self-collisions are off only from zero G1-vs-G1 contacts at the standing spawn, where no G1 geoms overlap even with self-collisions on; the line must name a pose that would collide so the check proves the configuration

ops.text: newton_scene.build('kitchen.xml') loads the scene with G1 self-collisions off in any pose and room/prop/person contacts on
